plainTranslation: Drive grinds against control. The Mars person feels slowed, judged, or thwarted; the Saturn person finds the other reckless. Real friction around effort, ambition, or sex. Failure mode: resentment and suppression, or one shutting the other down. Workable if both respect the tension; name the brake instead of fighting it in silence.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
